formulae.zero_run_days: longest consecutive run where point daily precipitation equals 0 mm
formulae.dry_day_fraction: zero-rain day count / point day count
formulae.regional_mean_mm: mean of the three regional event-window precipitation means

decision_rule.conclusion: The downgrade fails only when all three numeric thresholds are met.

criteria.name: answer_schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric units implied by field names.

criteria.name: point_rainfall_metrics
criteria.description: Computes 0.8 mm point precipitation, a 7-day zero-rain run, and a 13/15 = 0.867 dry-day fraction.

criteria.name: regional_contrast_metrics
criteria.description: Uses the three regional means 45.3, 68.2, and 109.0 mm to compute a 74.2 mm mean and 56.7 minimum regional/source ratio.

criteria.name: threshold_test
criteria.description: Applies all three thresholds: point_total_mm <= 1.0, zero_run_days >= 7, and min_regional_ratio >= 50.

criteria.name: computed_consequence
criteria.description: Concludes washout_downgrade_fails because the source point remains very dry despite wet regional summaries.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation to the computed rainfall contrast without broad event narration or unsupported impact claims.
